# Development installers

Current: [V2 Development Build 7](wallaby-agent_2.0.0~dev7_amd64.deb). Verify [SHA256SUMS.txt](SHA256SUMS.txt). Development only; Stable is unchanged. Unsigned vault composition/signature-return/broadcast use Dashboard Build 8. Wallet sync additionally requires [the signed-preview relay update](../DASHBOARD_PREVIEW_UPDATE.md); the Agent refuses old requests until it is present. Historical packages remain for reference. [Read the signing audit warning and current limitations](../README.md) before use.
